tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Gosoor blue. Primary button fill, active nav, selected state, focus ring. Text in `on-brand` on it. As text only 16px+ on `surface`; for links use `brand-ink`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` fills (4.9:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Link and inline brand text on `surface`, `ground` and `brand-tint` (≥5.6:1 both themes).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected table rows, info chips, B2B price-tier highlight. Text on it: `ink` or `brand-ink`.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Gosoor navy. Storefront top bar, footer, vendor-portal sidebar, B2B mode band. Text in `on-navy`.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `navy` (16:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive nav items on `navy` (8.3:1+).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sale / New badge fill and sale price text on `surface` only (4.6:1). Never for buttons, never on `ground` text (4.2:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` badge fills.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind surfaces; app canvas in the vendor portal.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, product tiles, forms.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, sticky headers over content (pair with `shadow-2`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `brand-tint` (≥13:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata, placeholders on every surface (≥6.3:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders (≥3:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline + 2px offset on every focusable element (≥3.5:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: In stock, paid, quote accepted. Always with icon + word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background for success chips and banners; text in `success`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low stock, payment due soon, quote expiring. Always with icon + word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background for warning chips and banners; text in `warning`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, overdue invoice, rejected quote, destructive actions. Always with icon + word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background for error banners and invalid-field hints; text in `danger`.

tokens.name: glass-ground
tokens.usage: Login screen only: black abstract backdrop base.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Login card fill over `glass-ground` with backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: Login card edge and input borders on glass.

tokens.name: glass-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the login glass card (18:1 on the dark ground).

tokens.name: glass-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and helper text on the login glass card (9.7:1).

tokens.name: glass-brand
tokens.usage: Brand-colored text on the login glass card, e.g. "Commerce" in the wordmark (7.3:1 on `glass-ground`).

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles: storefront category headers, vendor dashboard page name. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles, product name on product page.
styles.sample: Kilim wool rug, Nile Art 1 × 1.5 m

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and card group headings, checkout steps.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles, table group headers, form section labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI and running text. Prose max 70ch.
styles.sample: Ships from Alexandria in 10–14 days. Minimum order 50 pieces.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Prices in lists, emphasized values, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, table cells in dense mode.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, chips, tiny labels. Never below 12px.

styles.name: ar-title
styles.usage: Arabic section titles; taller leading for Arabic ascenders.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Arabic running text: one step larger than `body` for the same visual size.
styles.sample: الشحن من الإسكندرية خلال ١٠–١٤ يومًا. الحد الأدنى للطلب ٥٠ قطعة.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: SKU, HS code, order and quote numbers, tabular figures in reports.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding-block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, badge padding-inline.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding-inline, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid, form section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page section spacing, desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Spacing between major storefront bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product tiles, panels, the login card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count bubbles and avatar only.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Product tile on hover only. Resting tiles use `line` edge, no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, mega-menu, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Login glass card only.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, autocomplete.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky header, sticky cart summary.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their backdrop (backdrop 399).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.
